title: Motion Subspace Canonicalization for Design-Intent Evaluation in CAD Sketches
selection_rationale: 用官方数据集中真实保存的 CAD 预览替代 GitHub 标题卡。比较全部保存预览后，选择轮廓清楚且约束标记没有被画面边界截断的两例；保留原约束与背景。它们是数据示例，并非模型预测或论文结果图。
limitations: No public paper PDF located. Thumbnail shows original author-released dataset previews, not a paper screenshot.

title: PanDA: Panoptic Domain Adaptation for Multimodal Perception in Autonomous Driving
selection_rationale: The introductory two-block concept illustration is much simpler and more colourful than the complete training architecture. RGB/LiDAR corruption and the broken-to-complete instance remain recognisable as a thumbnail.

title: Patch-as-Decodable-Token: Towards Unified Multi-Modal Vision Tasks in MLLMs
selection_rationale: A coherent 2×2 selection of actual box/mask outputs makes direct visual prediction obvious without requiring readers to decipher a token architecture. The couch and food scenes provide clear objects and strong red-mask contrast. These are selected output panels from the same figure, not a new experiment.

title: Thinking Ahead: Foresight Intelligence in MLLMs and World Models
selection_rationale: Selected frames retain the original yellow historical and green future framing, plus object boxes and counterfactual paths. Two chronological sequences are easier to recognise than the overview card with benchmark statistics. Frames are nonconsecutive samples from the same two illustrated cases, with the original order preserved.

title: MonoSR: Open-Vocabulary Spatial Reasoning from Monocular Images
selection_rationale: Six source photographs are arranged as three domain columns instead of a long six-example strip. The existing scene markers remain intact. Photographs occupy the thumbnail rather than fine-print QA text; these are illustrations of dataset coverage, not model predictions.

title: One Agent to Guide Them All: Empowering MLLMs for Vision-and-Language Navigation via Explicit World Representation
selection_rationale: A crop of the real quadruped deployment gives a single clear robot and environment, replacing the dense three-module pipeline. It is explicitly a real-world demonstration panel, not an aggregate quantitative result. Only the later section of the quadruped sequence is shown.

title: Perception-Aware Multimodal Spatial Reasoning from Monocular Images
selection_rationale: Four intact example cards make the actual geometric questions concrete, while retaining task titles, predictions and ground-truth indicators. Cropping from six to four cards avoids compressing the already small scene images into a wide strip.

title: Talk2Escape: Conversational Grounding for Vision-and-Language Navigation
selection_rationale: The real robot, red failure mark, green recovery mark and short dialogue convey the paper’s purpose immediately. This is a more distinctive visual story than a full control-and-language pipeline and keeps both the failure and correction context intact.

title: Efficient Online Robotic Reinforcement Learning with Explicit Manifold Alignment
selection_rationale: 保留原 teaser 中最直观的真实机器人与两类失败轨迹，去掉右侧密集性能柱状图。原有 On-/Off-manifold 标记完整保留，未改变轨迹或比较含义。
limitations: Selected from the official project teaser; not claimed to be a full-paper review.

title: Prioritizing Faithfulness: Efficient Zero-Shot Novel View Synthesis via Homography-Guided SA-RePaint
selection_rationale: 从原六方法拼图中只取 Ours 的一个完整输出视图，主体清晰，适合小尺寸展示。选用镜头已经明显拉远的第 18 帧；它是单个结果示例，不用于宣称优于基线。
limitations: No accessible full paper PDF; chosen image is the official demonstration output.

title: Sam-Guided Multi-View Fusion for Weakly Supervised 3D Point Cloud Segmentation
selection_rationale: The original nine-column ablation grid becomes a faithful three-column RGB / ours (1 point) / GT selection, covering three scenes. Warm-coloured room geometry and coherent masks remain visible; unrelated baseline columns are omitted and the retained column meanings are recorded.

title: Global-Aware Monocular Semantic Scene Completion with State Space Models
selection_rationale: Input, ground truth and the proposed coloured voxel reconstruction for two rooms show the input-to-3D task in a glance. The selected columns replace a five-column method comparison and remove a dense encoder architecture. Column order and source row identities are preserved in the record.

title: Future-Aware Interaction Network For Motion Forecasting
selection_rationale: The paired intersections and vivid blue/purple trajectories make motion forecasting recognisable at small size. Both comparison panels and original labels are retained, while the network’s many tiny module diagrams are removed.

title: Seeground: See and ground for zero-shot open-vocabulary 3d visual grounding
selection_rationale: Two large room renderings with visible correct/incorrect object outlines provide a cleaner grounding example than six thin columns. The original queries remain with their matching images and no method comparison is fabricated.

title: VaLID: Variable-Length Input Diffusion for Novel View Synthesis
selection_rationale: Six selected outputs from the VaLID four-input-view row show recognisable objects from different angles, rather than shrinking a full 72-image comparison. The 3×2 arrangement is explicitly a selected-output gallery, not a new comparison or claimed animation.

title: SiFH: Siamese Frequency Harmonization Self-Supervised Learning for Motion Forecasting
selection_rationale: 用实际转弯场景中的彩色轨迹替代复杂预训练框图；裁出左转、右转两列并保留方法行标，避免缩略图塞入四种场景。
limitations: Full journal PDF unavailable; reading limited to publicly accessible text and publisher figures.

title: Tfnet: Exploiting temporal cues for fast and accurate lidar semantic segmentation
selection_rationale: 从完整框图换成 Fig. 5 的 Ours / GT 两列。彩色点云、树干及原文红色圈注在缩略图中比网络模块更直观；保留两列标签，避免把真值当成输出。

title: MS-TCN++: Multi-Stage Temporal Convolutional Network for Action Segmentation
selection_rationale: 使用 Fig. 10(a) 的完整视频帧与三行动作条带。它直接表达“长视频分段”，兼有真实图像和彩色时间轴，优于旧的纵向卷积结构图。保留 GT 与模型行标。

title: Foresight Social-aware Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation
selection_rationale: 改用原文 Fig. 2 的机器人、行人和分岔路径，突出“提前避障”的核心。图像主体明确，无密集框图；保留原始路径和时间标记。

title: Dual Pyramid Generative Adversarial Networks for Semantic Image Synthesis
selection_rationale: 从 Fig. 1 中选择输入语义图和 DP-GAN 输出两列、前两个场景，连同原始列标拼排。能在小图中直接看懂从布局生成街景；不包含基线输出，不暗示所选图就是全面性能比较。

title: Moving object segmentation in 3D LiDAR data: A learning-based approach exploiting sequential data
selection_rationale: 选择 Fig. 7(b) 的完整清洁地图面板。蓝色道路与建筑构成清楚的大主体，展示动态物体剔除的实际地图结果；没有把它标为语义分割图。

title: Multi-scale interaction for real-time lidar data segmentation on an embedded platform
selection_rationale: 选 Fig. 4(d) 的模型结果面板，直接展示黑底彩色城市点云和车辆。保留原文圈注，不移除失败处，因此没有粉饰结果。

title: Rethinking 3-D LiDAR point cloud segmentation
selection_rationale: 选 Fig. 14 中 nuScenes 预测的单个完整场景。大幅彩色点云比 Fig. 9 整体网络图更适合作为主页封面；只展示模型结果，不拼接真值冒充输出。

title: Spatial-temporal consistency network for low-latency trajectory forecasting
selection_rationale: 选 Fig. 5 右列 STC-Net 的一个完整场景。真实航拍背景与红/蓝/黄轨迹比整张网络图更容易传达轨迹预测任务；颜色沿用原文定义。

title: MiniSeg: An Extremely Minimum Network for Efficient COVID-19 Segmentation
selection_rationale: 从 Fig. 4 中选首个病例的 CT 输入和 MiniSeg 输出，并保留原列名。两张大图即可看懂任务，避免将十列结果压成细小条带；保留全部原始红绿蓝误差编码。

title: Pose Refinement Graph Convolutional Network for Skeleton-based Action Recognition
selection_rationale: 选择 Fig. 8 上排前两个完整 Original/Refined 骨架对，清楚展示姿态修正。蓝色人体骨架留白干净，任务一眼可辨，优于长条网络架构。

title: Refinedbox: Refining for fewer and high-quality object proposals
selection_rationale: 选首图的马匹与框精修前后示例，原始 Refine 箭头、排名和回归说明保留。主体鲜明，比网络分支结构图更适合缩略图。

title: Joint salient object detection and existence prediction
selection_rationale: 从 Fig. 5 选有花朵与纯背景两个完整例子，拼排输入与 SSVM 两列，并保留原列名。既有鲜明黄色花朵，也表达“无显著物体时不误报”的区别，不只挑漂亮正例掩盖论文主题。

title: Del: Deep embedding learning for efficient image segmentation
selection_rationale: 选 Fig. 6 的前两行输入与 DEL 分割两列。人物与彩色区域有清楚的对应关系，比旧的管线图更生动；没有将基线结果拼入本文列。

title: Direct line guidance odometry
selection_rationale: 保留首图这个本来就合适的任务画面，重新精确裁去周边页边与空白。走廊透视和绿色线特征有鲜明视觉主体，且直接对应 line-guided odometry。

title: Structured skip list: A compact data structure for 3D reconstruction
selection_rationale: A single furnished-room reconstruction gives an immediate readable demonstration of the 3D output. The other diagrams explain data structures, while page 6 spreads several smaller meshes across a wide strip.

title: GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
selection_rationale: The room example is explicitly illustrative in the Figure 1 caption; it is the visual premise of Figure 1: a viewpoint, objects, and an egocentric spatial relation are visible without requiring tiny architecture labels. Selected only the self-contained annotated room panel, not unrelated schematic comparisons.

title: Aligning Thoughts with Answers: Probability Rewards to Tame Thinking Drift
selection_rationale: Figure 1 makes the failure and correction concrete in one kitchen scene, with existing red/green reasoning cards. This is clearer than the abstract token/reward training diagram; no comparison labels are removed.

title: Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning
selection_rationale: The original overview remains the most effective visual: real cooking frames lead into executable rules and state. Its native image is tightly cropped to remove surrounding body text and caption. The appendix compiler is denser, and result plots do not communicate the video-to-world task as directly.

title: PRISM: Planning and Reasoning with Intent in Simulated embodied environments
selection_rationale: The apartment-level floor-plan panel cleanly shows the benchmark scale and varied environments. At a homepage size, it communicates more than the full overview text cards or the small, dark execution-trace frames.

title: Grounding by Remembering: Cross-Scene and In-Scene Memory for 3D Functional Affordances
selection_rationale: The complete left task panel shows cross-scene memory directing grounding from a broad door region to its operable handle. Choosing this one visual highlight gives the door/handle images enough space to remain visible at homepage size; original panel labels and failure/solution cues remain intact.

title: IntentionNav: A Benchmark for Intent-Driven Object Navigation from Implicit Human Instruction
selection_rationale: The expanded conceptual illustration connects an indirect request to plausible object hypotheses, a scene map and grounded visual evidence. It uses larger environment imagery than the narrow pipeline and remains faithful to its caption: an explanatory task illustration, not a new experimental result.

title: Ask When It Pays: Cost-Aware Open-Ended Interaction for Instance Goal Navigation
selection_rationale: The matched floor-plan trajectories communicate a question’s benefit in one glance: uncertain search versus a corrected route. The original No QA / Spatial QA labels and the question/answer cue remain visible, preserving comparison context.

title: AI for Auto-Research: Roadmap & User Guide
selection_rationale: The four illustrated stages are already the strongest small-format figure: distinct characters, colors and a simple lifecycle. Retained this figure after comparison, using its actual illustration bounds without extra whitespace or caption.

title: Think, Then Look: Active Spatial Reasoning for House-Scale 3D Scene Understanding
selection_rationale: The introductory task example is unusually good already: a large house cutaway, selected views, and a visible question-guided inspection path. Kept the complete task narrative and corrected cropping to avoid surrounding paper text; the alternative tool diagram is less visually distinctive.

title: Improving the Generalization of Segmentation Foundation Models via Weakly-Supervised and Unsupervised Adaptation
selection_rationale: 裁出扩展版 WeSAM++ 方法图右上角两个完整提示示例，直接展示弱标签与无标签设置，去掉密集 teacher/student 框架。两幅图保留 Weak Labels / No Labels 原始标记；它们是方法示例，不是性能对比结果。
limitations: Journal PDF and standalone journal result-image download returned 403. The selected image is a verified crop of the current WeSAM++ author-hosted framework figure.

title: DiffPCN: Latent Diffusion Model Based on Multi-view Depth Images for Point Cloud Completion
selection_rationale: Selected two qualitative object examples for Input, Our and GT. These original figure columns show incomplete versus completed shape directly; two rows fit a teaser far better than the full multi-method matrix. Native PDF images are arranged as a faithful two-row, three-column excerpt; original column labels are retained from the same figure, with no new labels or changed colors.

title: Multi-View Industrial Anomaly Detection with Epipolar Constrained Cross-View Fusion
selection_rationale: The USB example shows recognizable object views and colored anomaly maps. Selected the first three views from the complete USB half, preserving its Image/UniAD/PatchCore/Ours column labels and ground-truth masks so the comparison remains interpretable.
